title: Confirm intent-2/twins-3: 0.15 um offset joints on route_c_in cost 1.7 dB each, 3.4 dB on the loopback
evidence: Offset table (work/physics/mm.py, single-mode mode matching with E x H overlap, modes power-normalised, reflection term included): offset 0.005 -> 0.002 dB, 0.025 -> 0.048, 0.05 -> 0.19, 0.10 -> 0.76, 0.15 -> 1.70, 0.25 -> 4.55 dB per joint; reflection 0 (same cross-section). A scalar H-field overlap gives a larger 2.8 dB at 0.15 um, so 1.7 dB/joint is the optimistic end. Mode 1/e^2 intensity full width 0.67 um. route_c_in centre y=508.150 vs pins at 508.000 at both ends (GC4 opt1 and crossing opt2).
impact: 3.4 dB (range 3.4-5.6 dB) unplanned loss on the loopback GC4->GC5, the reference path that normalises both MZIs. Critical (>1 dB).
fix: Move route_c_in to y=508.000 (centre on the pins).

title: Confirm twins-6/intent-5: two R=2 um bends cost 0.08 dB each, +0.13 dB on MZI B output vs R=5
evidence: Bend table (work/physics/bends.py, bend2.py; local Tidy3D mode solver, 10 nm grid, PML, 4 modes to skip spurious PML modes): R=2.0: n_eff 2.449, k 2.7e-6 -> radiation 0.0003 dB/90deg, straight-to-bend mismatch 0.040 dB per joint -> 0.080 dB per 90deg bend; R=2.5: 0.025 dB/joint; R=3: 0.017; R=4: 0.0095; R=5: 0.006 (0.012 dB per bend); R=10: 0.0016. Mismatch scales as 1/R^2 as expected. Note: with only 2 modes the R=2 solve locks onto a spurious PML mode (n_eff 2.72, k 0.19); pick the core-confined TE mode.
impact: 0.16 dB for the two bends (0.13 dB above R=5 bends) on GC2->GC3, insertion loss only, outside the interferometer. Medium (each bend above the 0.05 dB budget). Model has about +-0.02 dB/joint uncertainty.
fix: Use the PDK R=5 um bend (as routes A and C).

title: Confirm twins-7/intent-3: GC3 2 um off the 127 um pitch costs 0.32-0.64 dB of fibre coupling
evidence: Gaussian fibre-mode overlap, MFD 10.4 um (w0 5.2 um): T = exp(-(d/w0)^2): d=0.1 -> 0.002 dB, 0.5 -> 0.04, 1.0 -> 0.16, 2.0 -> 0.64 dB. GC origins y 0, 127, 254, 383, 508, 635.1. With a rigid 127 um array, splitting the error on GC2/GC3 leaves 1 um each (0.32 dB total); aligning on the other GCs leaves 2 um on GC3 (0.64 dB). Grating-coupler mode is not Gaussian, so +-30%.
impact: 0.3-0.6 dB extra loss on MZI B (GC2->GC3) and an alignment compromise. Medium.
fix: Place GC3 at y=381.0 and re-route route_b_out to it.

title: Confirm microscope-1/twins-2: 0.5 um gap in MZI B short arm = 6-7 dB in that arm; MZI B peak -2.5 dB, extinction only ~9 dB
evidence: Local mode expansion (work/physics/eme_yee.py: 100 modes of a PEC box 4 x 2.8 um, Yee fields, edges on grid lines): 0.5 strip -> 0.5 um oxide -> 0.5 strip T = 0.24 (6.2 dB; 5.8 dB after the completeness correction T(L)/T(0)); 2-D Gaussian diffraction estimate 10 dB. Facet reflection ~ -12 dB each (n_eff 2.44 vs 1.44), so a weak etalon adds +-0.5 dB ripple and back-reflection. MZI with one arm down by x dB (ideal Y-branches): 6 dB -> peak 2.5 dB, ER 9.6 dB; 7 dB -> 2.8 dB, ER 8.3 dB (work/physics/mzi.py). The gap also adds 0.33 um to the group-equivalent dL (60.34 -> 60.67 um).
impact: MZI B GC2->GC3: ~2.5-2.8 dB excess at the fringe peak and extinction ~8-10 dB instead of >25 dB; a -12 dB reflector inside the MZI. High.
fix: Close the gap: one continuous 0.5 um Si waveguide from x=47.4 to 192.6 at y=256.75.

title: Confirm twins-1: 5 um Si Slab section in MZI A short arm = 1.5-2.0 dB in the arm (dead arm if 2/0 is not fabricated)
evidence: Si -> 90 nm Si Slab strip (0.5 um) junction: fundamental overlap 0.80 (0.95-0.97 dB per end; rv.junction_loss and my 100-mode check agree), reflection -18.8 dB per end (work/physics/mm.py). Mode expansion through the 5 um section: 1.5-2.0 dB (work/physics/eme_yee.py). Slab strip n_eff 1.685, n_g 2.97 vs 2.440 / 4.18 for the strip: +15 rad of phase (fringe moves ~0.4 FSR) and group-equivalent dL 79.94 -> 81.4 um. MZI with one arm down 1.5-2.0 dB: peak -0.7 to -0.9 dB, ER 19-21 dB. If layer 2/0 is not fabricated in the run, this is a 5 um oxide gap: Gaussian diffraction > 30 dB, arm dead, MZI A peak ~-3 dB with no useful fringes.
impact: Single unplanned loss of 1.5-2 dB in an MZI A arm (critical by the 1 dB rule), 0.7-0.9 dB at the GC0->GC1 fringe peak, ER limited to ~20 dB, fringe shifted. Worse (dead arm) if 2/0 is not made.
fix: Draw the 5 um piece on Si (1/0) like the rest of the arm.

title: Confirm twins-5: 2 um x 0.25 um neck in route_a_out costs 1.9-3.3 dB (high)
evidence: 0.25 um strip: n_eff 1.60, n_g 3.06 (barely guided). Fundamental overlap 0.5 -> 0.25: 0.806-0.81 (0.86-0.94 dB per step; tool and 100-mode check agree), so 1.9 dB if nothing is recaptured. Full mode expansion over the 2.0 um neck (radiated part recaptured with its phase): 2.96 dB raw, 3.3 dB after the completeness correction. Width table (fundamental E x H overlap per abrupt step): 0.45 -> <0.01, 0.40 -> <0.02, 0.35 -> <0.05, 0.30 -> 0.04-0.05, 0.25 -> 0.86-0.94 dB: the loss jumps between 0.30 and 0.25 um because the mode is near cut-off.
impact: 1.9-3.3 dB on the MZI A output path (Y-branch #7 -> GC1), outside the interferometer (no fringe change). Critical by the 1 dB rule.
fix: Restore the 0.5 um width over y = 19.024..21.024 at x = 265.

title: Confirm twins-4 at the low end of medium: 0.30 um input route of MZI A costs ~0.1-0.15 dB
evidence: 0.5 -> 0.3 um abrupt step: fundamental E x H overlap 0.988 (rv.junction_loss 0.052 dB) and 0.990 in my 100-mode Yee-grid solve (0.043 dB); reflection -34 dB. Two steps ~0.09-0.10 dB. 0.30 strip n_eff 1.83, n_g lower; more field at the sidewalls, so sidewall scattering maybe 2-3x the 0.5 um strip: +0.01-0.03 dB over 32.6 um. A scalar-H overlap (not the right quantity for high contrast) would give 0.41 dB per step; I do not use it.
impact: ~0.1-0.15 dB extra on GC0->GC1, outside the interferometer. Medium (low end), each step at the 0.05 dB limit.

title: Confirm intent-1: MZI A dL 79.94 um gives FSR 7.19 nm instead of 5.75 nm (25% off, far outside tolerance)
evidence: rv.modes(0.5): n_eff 2.440, n_g 4.181 at 1550 nm. FSR = lambda^2/(n_g dL): A layout 79.944 um -> 7.188 nm, intent 100.0 -> 5.746 nm; the +-0.5 um tolerance is +-0.03 nm. With the Si Slab piece (physics-c5) the group-equivalent dL is 81.4 um (FSR 7.06 nm). MZI B: 60.342 um -> 9.523 nm vs 9.577 nm (in tolerance; 60.67 um group-equivalent with its 0.5 um gap).
impact: MZI A does not have the designed free spectral range: the circuit does not do its function. High.
fix: Lengthen each vertical leg of route_a_long by 10.03 um (34.264 -> 44.29 um).

title: Confirm twins-10/intent-c7 harmless optically; and twins-8/intent-4, twins-9 harmless with numbers
evidence: Crossing at 90 deg: 4-fold symmetric (twins/intent), straight-through pair unchanged: 0 dB. GC5 at y=635.1: fibre offset 0.1 um -> 0.002 dB (Gaussian, w0 5.2 um); its R=5 S-bend: 2 straight-arc joints 0.006 dB each + one curvature reversal (~4x, 0.024 dB) -> ~0.035 dB, below the 0.05 dB limit. route_b_in 5 nm offset: 0.002 dB per joint (offset table). All pins scanned (work/physics/pinscan.py): no other offset or width step at any device pin.
impact: None. Crossing: LVS pin names only. route_b_in: DRC notch only (fix for a clean deck).
fix: Optional: rotate crossing to 0 deg or update intent_nets; snap route_b_in to y=254.0.

title: Detail of rules-c5: the 0.3 um route has almost no Fabry-Perot; reflection per joint is about -34 dB, not 2%
evidence: Single-mode mode matching with power-normalised E x H overlaps (work/physics/mm.py): 0.5 -> 0.3 um joint r = (c21 - c12)/(c12 + c21) gives R = 4e-4 (-34 dB); the n_eff Fresnel formula ((2.44-1.83)/(2.44+1.83))^2 = 2% overstates it, because the mode shape changes with the index. With R ~ -34 dB per joint the 32.6 um etalon ripple is ~0.01 dB p-p, not 0.3 dB. (For comparison: Si -> 90 nm slab joint R = -18.8 dB.)
impact: Severity stays medium: ~0.1-0.15 dB from the two joints plus scattering, no meaningful ripple.
